summary: Per-tick update for a timed text-overlay display (commentary/subtitles). Bails out unless the session is active (dword_7D0308), the track condition is positive (flt_7CF3C8) and the init flag at this+0xAF0 is set. It steps the audio/text overlay object, manages a pending-display flag with last-display timestamp, decrements a cooldown counter, renders active overlay text through the font subsystem when a slot's elapsed time passes its threshold, then resets and compacts the slots.

If overlay object *(this+0xAF4) is non-null, invoke vfunc+0x18 (update/process) on it via its vtable (read at *(this+0xAF4)).
Guard: when object *(this+0xAF4) is non-null, vfunc+8 returns 0 (not busy) and pending flag *(this+0xAE4) is set, begin a new display cycle.
Start display cycle: clear pending flag *(this+0xAE4)=0, set last-display timestamp *(this+0xAE8)=dbl_8AFEA8, reset active overlay id *(this+0xAEC)=-1.
ArraySlotCompactionWithGapFilling(this) compacts or fills the overlay slot array before the active-slot checks.
Guard (guard:0): current slot index *(this+0x864) == -1 means no active slot; if the object is ready (vfunc+8 == 0) reset active id *(this+0xAEC)=-1 and return 0.
Guard: return 0 when overlay object *(this+0xAF4) is null or its vfunc+8 returns non-zero (busy).
Cooldown handling on counter *(this+0x135C): when (dbl_8AFEA8 - last-display timestamp at *(this+0xAE8)) exceeds dword_7CF278 and the counter is positive, decrement it; otherwise no display is due.
Guard: if dbl_8AFEA8 < threshold *(this+0x86C), set active id *(this+0xAEC)=-1 and return 0 (too early to display).
Guard: when elapsed time (dbl_8AFEA8 - per-slot timestamp at 4*slot+2808) is at least the per-slot threshold flt_5BF9AC[5*slot], render the overlay text for the active slot.
Loop: initialize three temporary text-render structs in the v15 stack buffer, zeroing fields, setting sentinel -1 values and filling each string with StringCopyWithBufferRealloc(&byte_5EA438).

Guard: when v8 > 0 and the overlay object *(this+0xAF4) is non-null, render by invoking vfunc+4 with (v15, v8, 0).
On successful render: set pending flag *(this+0xAE4)=1, active overlay id *(this+0xAEC)=slot, and slot timestamp (4*slot+2808)=dbl_8AFEA8.
Loop: free the three temporary render strings via FreeWrapper_7bcf after rendering.
StructInitWithSentinelValues(this+0x864) resets the active overlay slot structure to sentinel defaults.
ArraySlotCompactionWithGapFilling(this) compacts the slot array again after the reset.
Return 0 on the various early-out paths and after the completed display/reset sequence.
